facts.question: How long are backups kept on the Enterprise plan?
facts.sentence: Enterprise backups are kept for 365 days; Team backups for 90 days; Basic for 30 days.

facts.question: How often are Enterprise databases backed up?
facts.sentence: Basic databases are backed up once a day, Team databases every 12 hours and Enterprise databases every 6 hours.

facts.question: How long can a deleted resource be recovered on the Team plan?
facts.sentence: A deleted resource can be recovered for 7 days on Basic, 14 days on Team and 30 days on Enterprise.

facts.question: How long does Northwind keep data after an account is closed?
facts.sentence: When an account is closed, Northwind keeps its data for 60 days so that the owner can export it.

facts.question: What is the charge for paying an invoice late?
facts.sentence: Payments received more than 15 days late incur a charge of 1.5% of the amount due.

facts.question: How long is the free trial of the Team plan?
facts.sentence: A 30-day trial of the Team plan is available to every new account.

facts.question: How much does extra storage cost?
facts.sentence: Storage beyond the included amount costs $0.021 per GB per month, and egress beyond the included bandwidth costs $0.05 per GB.

facts.question: How quickly are critical vulnerabilities fixed?
facts.sentence: Critical vulnerabilities found by the test are fixed within 7 days, and high-severity ones within 30 days.

facts.question: How much notice do I need to cancel a monthly contract?
facts.sentence: Cancellations require 30 days' written notice on monthly contracts.

facts.question: How quickly does revoking a customer-managed key make the data unreadable?
facts.sentence: Enterprise customers can supply their own encryption keys, which they can revoke at any time; revoking a key makes the data unreadable within 15 minutes.

facts.question: What hours is support available on the Team plan?
facts.sentence: Team and Basic requests are handled between 06:00 and 20:00 UTC on weekdays, and requests that arrive outside those hours wait until the next working morning.

facts.question: How often does the technical account manager hold a review call?
facts.sentence: Each Enterprise account has a named technical account manager who holds a review call every quarter, covering usage, incidents and upcoming product changes.

facts.question: What discount does annual prepayment give on the Team plan?
facts.sentence: Annual prepayment earns a discount of 10% on Team and 15% on Enterprise.

facts.question: How many regions can Team customers choose from for their data?
facts.sentence: Enterprise customers can pick any of the 14 regions, Team customers can pick from 3 regions in their continent, and Basic accounts are placed in the region closest to the account owner.

facts.question: How many units did Trailhead Outfitters sell in 2025?
facts.sentence: Trailhead Outfitters sold 115,444 units across its 15 products and 6 regions in 2025.

facts.question: Which product sold the most units in 2025?
facts.sentence: Trail Shoes was the best-selling product with 11,852 units, and Gaiters sold the fewest, with 2,985 units.

facts.question: Which region was the strongest in 2025?
facts.sentence: Pacific was the strongest region with 29,305 units, ahead of Mountain with 21,677 units.

facts.question: Which quarter had the most unit sales?
facts.sentence: The strongest quarter was Q4, with 36,978 units, and the weakest was Q1, with 20,461 units.

facts.question: What share of units were sold online?

facts.question: How many stores does the Pacific region operate?
facts.sentence: The Pacific region operates 19 stores, more than any other region.

facts.question: When are online orders counted as sold?
facts.sentence: Units are counted at the point of sale for stores and at the dispatch date for online orders.

facts.question: Are returns deducted from the sales figures?
facts.sentence: Returns are not deducted from the quarter in which the sale was recorded; they are reported separately in the finance pack.

facts.question: Which states does the Mountain region cover?
facts.sentence: The Mountain region covers Colorado, Utah and Wyoming.

facts.question: Which temporary store is included in the Mountain region figures?
facts.sentence: Figures for the Mountain region include the Boulder pop-up store, which traded from 1 June to 30 September 2025 and is not counted among the 9 permanent stores.

facts.question: When did the Camp Stove promotion run?
